Provides a complete chronological record: Provides a complete chronological record of all cash receipts, payouts, shop expenses, credit auctions, and consignment arrivals across the entire Mandi shop.
Tracks historical opening till cash befo: Tracks historical opening till cash before start date, processes daily cash receipts/sales as Jama (Inflows), beopari/grower payouts/expenses as Banam (Outflows), and maintains true double-entry closing till balances.
Displays complete debit, credit, and run: Displays complete debit, credit, and running balance history for a chosen party, with a summary card showing current outstanding balance.
Filters all ledger entries and transacti: Filters all ledger entries and transactions by party ID. Debits represent purchases or funds owed; Credits represent payments or settlements received. Running balance is updated sequentially: Balance = Previous Balance + Debit - Credit.
Tracks auction liquidation per consignme: Tracks auction liquidation per consignment lot, showing exact buyer names, crate quantities, rates, and total sales value.
Joins sales transactions with stock cons: Joins sales transactions with stock consignment lots. Amount = Quantity * Sale Rate. The totals row sums total crate quantity and total gross sales value.
Provides an executive view of agency rev: Provides an executive view of agency revenue generated from trade commission rates applied on sales transactions and beopari/grower lot settlements.
Calculates brokerage commission earned a: Calculates brokerage commission earned across transactions with options for All Parties, All Beopari/Growers, and All Customers. Shows customer sales commission and beopari/grower lot commission deductions with corresponding commission rates (percentage, per-unit, or fixed fee).
Categorizes buyer credit into aging time: Categorizes buyer credit into aging time buckets (0-7, 8-15, 16-30, 30+ days) to highlight overdue balances.
Computes unpaid invoice balances for eac: Computes unpaid invoice balances for each customer. Each unpaid transaction amount is assigned to an aging bucket based on days elapsed between invoice date and As-Of date. Highlighted in red if 30+ days overdue.
Monitors daily liquidity movement across: Monitors daily liquidity movement across cash drawers and bank accounts including walk-in cash customer sales, customer recoveries, beopari/grower payouts, and shop expenses.
Inflows (Customer Receipts & Walk-in Cas: Inflows (Customer Receipts & Walk-in Cash Sales) add to cash/bank balance (+); Outflows (Beopari/Grower Payouts & Expenses) subtract from balance (-). Opening Balance is computed prior to selected date range; Closing Balance = Opening + Total In - Total Out.
Tracks beopari/grower inward crates rece: Tracks beopari/grower inward crates received vs dispatched and customer outward crates issued vs returned.
Beopari/Grower Inward Ledger: Net Owed =: Beopari/Grower Inward Ledger: Net Owed = Inward Received - Dispatched to Beopari/Grower. Customer Outward Ledger: Net Pending = Crates Issued - Empty Crates Received from Buyer.
Helps shop clerks identify active grower: Helps shop clerks identify active growers with zero stock arrivals on a chosen date to trigger procurement outreach.
Scans registered active beopari/growers: Scans registered active beopari/growers whose latest StockEntry arrival date is strictly before the chosen As-Of date. Days Inactive = As-Of Date - Last Arrival Date.
Provides a complete audit of all expense: Provides a complete audit of all expense deductions withheld from beopari/grower consignment settlements per lot, distinguishing freight, labor/unloading, crate expenses, advance deductions, and beopari/grower commissions without mixing Mandi operating expenses.
For each consignment lot: Gross Amount =: For each consignment lot: Gross Amount = Sold Crate Revenue (or Arrival Lot Value). Commission Deducted = Percentage or Fixed rate per lot. Lot Expenses Deducted = Sum of specific lot expense items (Freight, Unloading, Crates, Municipal/Advance). Total Deductions = Commission + Lot Expenses. Net Payable = Gross Amount - Total Deductions.
Tracks pending financial settlements owe: Tracks pending financial settlements owed to growers after deducting commission, freight, labor, and prior advances.
Net Payable = (Gross Crate Sales - Commi: Net Payable = (Gross Crate Sales - Commission Deductions - Lot Expenses) - Payments Disbursed. Unpaid balances are categorized into aging intervals based on lot sale date.
Official register of fixed Market / Sark: Official register of fixed Market / Sarkari fees deducted per consignment lot.
Official register of fixed Market Commit: Official register of fixed Market Committee fees per consignment lot, tracking assessed amounts and settlement status.
Market / Sarkari Fee is a fixed amount p: Market / Sarkari Fee is a fixed amount per consignment lot. Summary tracks assessed turnover and total fixed fees accrued.
Detailed audit of per-consignment labor/: Detailed audit of per-consignment labor/freight deductions and shop overhead expenses grouped by expense categories.
Aggregates recorded shop expenses and lo: Aggregates recorded shop expenses and lot-specific deductions. Bar chart displays expense breakdown by category.
Helps commission agents and traders anal: Helps commission agents and traders analyze price trends, peak market rate periods, price corridor fluctuations, and commodity price seasonality.
Filters trade transactions by date range: Filters trade transactions by date range and selected commodity. Computes daily minimum rate, maximum rate, and quantity-weighted average selling rate (Total Value / Total Quantity). Line chart displays average trend line alongside high/low rate corridors.
Identifies key commercial partners, high: Identifies key commercial partners, highest volume growers, and most valuable buyers in the Mandi.
Sums quantity, trade value, and commissi: Sums quantity, trade value, and commission per party across sales and stock entries. Ranks parties in descending order for leaderboard visualization.
Evaluates shop profitability month-by-mo: Evaluates shop profitability month-by-month by comparing dual-sided brokerage commissions (Customer & Beopari/Grower) and miscellaneous income against total operational expenses.
Aggregated by Calendar Month. Total Comm: Aggregated by Calendar Month. Total Commission = Customer Commission + Beopari/Grower Commission. Total Revenue = Total Commission + Misc Income. Net Profit = Total Revenue - Total Expenses. Margin % = (Net Profit / Total Revenue) * 100.
Highlights unsold stock in shop storage: Highlights unsold stock in shop storage with perishability risk flags (Green/Yellow/Red) based on arrival age to prevent crop spoilage.
Filters StockEntries with remainingQuant: Filters StockEntries with remainingQuantity > 0. Days in Shop = Current Date - Arrival Date. Risk Level: High Risk (> 4 days, Red), Caution (2–4 days, Yellow), Normal (< 2 days, Green).
